output.application: The record returned by the service

oracle_taleo_candidate_status_changed_tr.description: Runs when a candidate's overall status changes.

output.candidate: The record returned by the service

output.candidate: The record returned by the service

output.candidate: The record returned by the service

oracle_taleo_new_contact_trigger.description: Runs when a contact is added.

output.contact: The record returned by the service

oracle_taleo_new_requisition_trigger.description: Runs when a requisition (job) is created.

output.requisition: The record returned by the service
